title: Fix Gadget Config Window Showing Only Hello World
instructions: Investigate and fix why the GadgetConfigWindow only shows "hello world" gadget when 5 gadgets are available. The test script confirmed all 5 checkboxes are created, but only 1 is visible in the UI. This suggests a layout/packing issue in the scrollable canvas.

1784835929.379884.instruction: Run Python code to instantiate GadgetManager and print detailed debug info about what gadgets are found, enabled, and what errors occur during loading. Check if there's a mismatch between what's configured and what's loaded.

1784835933.435031.instruction: Add debug output to run.py to verify display_gadgets() is called and how many gadgets it processes. Check if buttons are being created but not visible due to packing order or other UI issues.

1784835937.9362755.instruction: Examine the _create_gadget_checkboxes method in detail to understand why only one gadget is shown when multiple are available. Check if there's a UI update issue or if gadgets are being filtered.

1784835943.1596644.instruction: Apply fixes based on findings from previous tasks, then restart KosDWM and verify all gadgets appear in both panel and config menu.

1784837038.3453934.instruction: Read the _create_window and _create_gadget_checkboxes methods in src/gadgets.py to understand how the scrollable frame is set up. Look for issues with canvas scrolling, frame packing, or widget visibility.

1784837044.6142244.instruction: Modify the GadgetConfigWindow to properly configure the scrollregion and ensure the gadgets_frame expands correctly. The issue is likely that the canvas doesn't know how large the scrollable area should be.

1784837048.3814185.instruction: Restart KosDWM and open the gadget config window to verify all 5 gadgets (hello_world, test_gadget, notices, cpu_monitor, system_info) are now visible with checkboxes.
